sections.heading: Title page
sections.label: front-matter
sections.paraphrase: Title page: author, publisher, edition (10th 1994, WWW 1999), ISBN, the free-distribution line and dedication.

sections.heading: CONTENTS
sections.label: front-matter
sections.paraphrase: The web edition's table of contents.

sections.heading: PUBLISHERS’ NOTE
sections.label: front-matter
sections.paraphrase: Publishers' note: introduces Sivananda and calls the book both theory and practical methods for awakening Kundalini.

sections.heading: GURU STOTRA
sections.label: front-matter
sections.paraphrase: Guru Stotra: Sanskrit verses of homage to the guru with English renderings (Devanagari is in a legacy font and garbles).

sections.heading: DEVI STOTRA
sections.label: front-matter
sections.paraphrase: Devi Stotra: hymn to the Goddess (legacy-font Devanagari, transliteration, translation).

sections.heading: SIVA STOTRA
sections.label: front-matter
sections.paraphrase: Siva Stotra: verse asking Siva to forgive all faults of body, speech and mind.

sections.heading: THE FOUR STAGES OF SOUND
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: The four levels of sound (para, pasyanti, madhyama, vaikhari) from breath to speech.

sections.heading: PREFACE
sections.label: front-matter
sections.paraphrase: Preface: a devotional address to Mother Kundalini, ending with a Bengali hymn asking her to wake (legacy-font Devanagari).

sections.heading: PRAYER TO MOTHER KUNDALINI
sections.label: front-matter
sections.paraphrase: Prayer to Mother Kundalini asking her to rise from the root centre to the crown.

sections.heading: EXPERIENCES ON AWAKENING OF KUNDALINI
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Signs said to show awakening (visions, inner sounds, spontaneous bandhas, breath stopping); Ask material, never a target.

sections.heading: THE GRADATIONAL ASCENT OF THE MIND
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: The chakras as centres of vital force; the mind's ascent through them depends on purity.

sections.heading: PRANAYAMA FOR AWAKENING KUNDALINI
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Alternate-nostril breath counted in Oms 3:12:6 with the hold sent down to the root centre; 3 rounds twice daily.

sections.heading: KUNDALINI PRANAYAMA
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Breath with imagery: inhale while picturing the power rising centre by centre, short hold with mantra at the crown, exhale it back down.

sections.heading: KUNDALINI
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: What Kundalini is (coiled power at the root of seven centres) and that every sadhana aims at waking it.

sections.heading: Kundalini And Tantrik Sadhana
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Kundalini as the centre of Tantric sadhana: the Mother in the body to be raised to Siva.

sections.heading: Kundalini And Hatha Yoga
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: How Hatha Yoga approaches Kundalini: body discipline, nadi purification and breath control.

sections.heading: Kundalini And Raja Yoga
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Raja Yoga's eight-limbed mental path, which does not name Kundalini.

sections.heading: Kundalini And Vedanta
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Vedanta's view: only knowledge removes ignorance; Kundalini methods are not its concern.

sections.heading: Essence Of Kundalini Yoga
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Long essay (Woodroffe-style) on the meaning of Kundalini Yoga: microcosm, six centres, static and dynamic shakti.

sections.heading: PRELIMINARY
sections.label: front-matter
sections.paraphrase: Opening invocation of the Preliminary part: homage to Patanjali, Vyasa and the masters.

sections.heading: Foundation–Vairagya
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Dispassion as the foundation: worldly pleasures cannot give lasting peace.

sections.heading: What Is Yoga?
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Definitions of yoga as union and as stilling the mind's movements.

sections.heading: The Importance Of Kundalini Yoga
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Why Kundalini Yoga matters: union of the body's shakti with Siva brings samadhi and knowledge.

sections.heading: Important Qualifications Of A Sadhaka
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: Who is fit to practise: vitality, calm, faith, moderation, ethical virtues, openness to the guru, little talk.

sections.heading: Yogic Diet
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: Conduct and diet for the practitioner: discipline, gentleness, moderation; gluttony and sense-slavery block progress.

sections.heading: Sattvic Articles
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: List of sattvic foods recommended for practitioners (milk, grains, dal, certain vegetables and fruits).

sections.heading: Forbidden Articles
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: Foods to avoid: sour, hot, pungent, meat, eggs, fish, garlic, onion, alcohol, stale food.

sections.heading: Mitahara
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: Moderate eating (half food, quarter water, quarter empty); change diet gradually; fast rarely; no fuss about diet.

sections.heading: The Place For Yoga Sadhana
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: The place: secluded, clean, dry, quiet, ventilated room kept only for practice; stay in one place; a seat neither high nor low.

sections.heading: The Time
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: The time: cool hours and early morning; not on a full stomach; bathe before rather than after; not when agitated.

sections.heading: The Age
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: Age: limited practice under 18; best between 20 and 40; healthy people may begin after 50.

sections.heading: Necessity For A Yogic Guru
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: A teacher is needed for the practice, especially advanced Kundalini work; easy lessons may be done at home.

sections.heading: Who Is A Guru?
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Who a guru is and the disciple's attitude toward him.

sections.heading: Spiritual Power
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Transmission of spiritual power (shakti sanchara) by touch, sight or thought.

sections.heading: Yoga Nadis
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Nadis as subtle channels of prana and their numbers.

sections.heading: Spinal Column
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: The spinal column (meru danda) as the axis on which the centres sit.

sections.heading: Sukshma Sarira
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: The subtle body inside the physical one.

sections.heading: Kanda
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: The kanda, egg-shaped root of the nadis just above the root centre.

sections.heading: Spinal Cord
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: The spinal cord in Western anatomy as a frame for the subtle teaching.

sections.heading: Sushumna Nadi
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Sushumna, the central channel, and its inner layers.

sections.heading: Para-Sympathetic And Sympathetic System
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Sympathetic and parasympathetic chains compared with the side channels.

sections.heading: Ida And Pingala Nadis

sections.paraphrase: Ida and pingala: where they run and meet, and their moon/sun qualities.

sections.heading: Svara Sadhana
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: Science of the breath's flow (svara): which acts suit which nostril's flow.

sections.heading: How To Change The Flow In Nadis
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Simple ways to switch the dominant nostril (block one side, lie on one side, armpit pressure); two methods use nauli or khechari and are excluded.

sections.heading: Other Nadis
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Names of other nadis branching from the kanda.

sections.heading: Padmas Or Chakras
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: The chakras in the subtle body and their gross correspondences.

sections.heading: Petals On Chakras

sections.paraphrase: Petals of each chakra and the Sanskrit letters on them.

sections.heading: Muladhara Chakra

sections.heading: Svadhishthana Chakra
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Svadhishthana: location at the genital root, water element, symbols.

sections.heading: Manipura Chakra
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Manipura at the navel: fire element, ten petals, symbols.

sections.heading: Anahata Chakra
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Anahata at the heart: air element, twelve petals, symbols.

sections.heading: Vishuddha Chakra
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Vishuddha at the throat: ether element, sixteen petals.

sections.heading: Ajna Chakra
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Ajna between the eyebrows: seat of mind, two petals, Om as seed.

sections.heading: The Brain
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: The brain and cranial nerves in anatomical terms.

sections.heading: Brahmarandhra
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Brahmarandhra, the crown aperture (the fontanelle), called the dwelling of the soul.

sections.heading: Sahasrara Chakra
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Sahasrara at the crown, abode of Siva and goal of the ascent.

sections.heading: Lalana Chakra
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Lalana, a minor centre between ajna and the crown.

sections.heading: Summary Of The Previous Lessons
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Recap of the earlier lessons: purity, discipline, guru, nadis and chakras.

sections.heading: The Mysterious Kundalini
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: The mystery of Kundalini, with a hymn: the Goddess as all the elements.

sections.heading: How To Awaken The Kundalini
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: Prerequisites and warnings for awakening Kundalini: purity first, a guide, gradual practice; forced awakening harms; the six cleansing acts listed.

sections.heading: 1. Dhauti
sections.label: teacher-only
sections.paraphrase: Dhauti: swallowing a long cloth strip and other internal cleansing.

sections.heading: 2. Basti
sections.label: teacher-only
sections.paraphrase: Basti: yogic enema by abdominal churning or a tube in water.

sections.heading: 3. Neti
sections.label: teacher-only
sections.paraphrase: Neti: thread through the nose (teacher-only); a short paragraph on sniffing water could be split out later as needs-review.

sections.heading: 4. Nauli
sections.label: teacher-only
sections.paraphrase: Nauli: isolating and churning the abdominal muscles after full exhalation.

sections.heading: 5. Trataka
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Steady gazing at a picture, dot, Om, flame etc., then closing the eyes to see it inwardly; start at two minutes. Sun-gazing is teacher-only.

sections.heading: 6. Kapalabhati
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Rapid forcible exhalations from the abdomen with passive inhalation and no hold; 1 per second, 10 per round rising to 120.

sections.heading: What Is Prana?
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: What prana is: the universal energy behind all movement.

sections.heading: Five Pranas
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: The five pranas and their seats and functions.

sections.heading: Pranayama
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: The many kinds of pranayama; only some appear in the hatha texts.

sections.heading: Nadi Suddhi
sections.label: teacher-only
sections.paraphrase: Nadi purification with seed syllables: 16 counts in, 64 held, 32 out, cycling Yam, Ram, Tham, Vam, Lam with imagery. Long retention.

sections.heading: 1. Sukha Purvaka
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Easy alternate-nostril breath 3:12:6 Oms (1:4:2) with root lock and attention at the root centre; 6 rounds rising to 20.

sections.heading: 2. Bhastrika
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Bellows breath: 10 to 25 rapid breaths, then a deep inhale held comfortably and a slow exhale; 3 rounds to start.

sections.heading: 3. Suryabheda
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Inhale through the right nostril, hold with chin lock until sweat appears, exhale left. The hold makes it teacher-only.

sections.heading: 4. Ujjayi
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Slow inhale through both nostrils with a soft throat sound, comfortable hold, exhale through the left; may be done walking.

sections.heading: 5. Plavini
sections.label: teacher-only
sections.paraphrase: Plavini: swallowing air into the stomach to float; needs an expert.

sections.heading: 6. Pranic Healing
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Pranic healing: directing prana by touch or attention to heal; medical claims, never shipped as treatment.

sections.heading: 7. Distant Healing
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Distant healing: sending prana to a patient far away by appointment; medical claims.

sections.heading: Importance Of Pranayama
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Why pranayama matters for mind control.

sections.heading: Benefits Of Pranayama
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Claimed benefits of pranayama.

sections.heading: Instructions On Pranayama
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: Eighteen practical rules for pranayama: time, clean nostrils, no strain, beginners skip the hold (1:2), build the hold slowly, no suffocation.

sections.heading: Importance Of Asanas
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: The four meditation seats and the aim of sitting still for long periods.

sections.heading: 1. Padmasana (Lotus Pose)
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Padmasana (lotus): how to sit; a seat for the breath practices.

sections.heading: 2. Siddhasana (The Perfect Pose)
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Siddhasana: heel placement; a seat for the breath practices.

sections.heading: 3. Svastikasana (Prosperous Pose)
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Svastikasana and the simpler samasana.

sections.heading: 4. Sukhasana
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Sukhasana: any easy cross-legged seat with head, neck and trunk in line; a supported variant for older people.

sections.heading: 5. Sirshasana (Topsy Turvy Pose)
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Headstand: build from 5 seconds by 15 seconds a week; long holds claimed. Physical asana, outside the engine's scope.

sections.heading: 6. Sarvangasana (All-Members Pose)
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Shoulder stand with chin lock, building from 2 minutes.

sections.heading: 7. Matsyasana (Fish Posture)
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Fish pose, counter to the shoulder stand.

sections.heading: 8. Paschimottanasana
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Seated forward bend.

sections.heading: 9. Mayurasana (Peacock Pose)
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Peacock pose: balancing on the forearms.

sections.heading: 10. Ardha Matsyendrasana
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Half spinal twist.

sections.heading: 11. Vajrasana (The Adamantine Pose)
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Vajrasana: kneeling seat, also after meals.

sections.heading: 12. Urdhva Padmasana (Above Lotus Pose)
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Lotus legs in a headstand; only for those who hold a headstand 10 to 15 minutes.

sections.heading: Instructions On Asanas
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: Twenty instructions on asanas: empty stomach, regularity, a fixed set, steadiness, mild breath-holding.

sections.heading: Exercises
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Mudras and bandhas in general and the twelve the book teaches; claimed cures.

sections.heading: 1. Mula Bandha
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Root lock: contract the anus and draw the downward energy up; can be added to pranayama and meditation.

sections.heading: 2. Jalandhara Bandha
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Chin lock: chin pressed to the chest, used during the held breath.

sections.heading: 3. Uddiyana Bandha
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Abdominal lock: after a full exhalation, draw the belly in and up; at the end of the hold.

sections.heading: 4. Maha Mudra
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: One heel at the perineum, other leg out, hold the toe, inhale and hold with chin lock and brow gaze; each side.

sections.heading: 5. Maha Bandha
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Heel at the perineum, foot on the thigh, root lock and held breath with chin lock.

sections.heading: 6. Maha Vedha
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Maha vedha: in the held breath, raise and gently drop the buttocks on the ground.

sections.heading: 7. Yoga Mudra
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Sitting in lotus, exhale and fold forward until the forehead touches the ground.

sections.heading: 8. Viparitakarani Mudra
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Viparitakarani: legs up with hands supporting the hips; time built from a minute.

sections.heading: 9. Khechari Mudra
sections.label: teacher-only
sections.paraphrase: Khechari mudra: lengthening the tongue by cutting the frenum and turning it back into the nasal cavity.

sections.heading: 10. Vajroli Mudra
sections.label: teacher-only
sections.paraphrase: Vajroli mudra: urethral suction with a catheter.

sections.heading: 11. Shakti Chalana Mudra
sections.label: teacher-only
sections.paraphrase: Shakti chalana: forceful breath and root lock to drive Kundalini up; beating the kanda with the foot.

sections.heading: 12. Yoni Mudra
sections.label: practice
sections.paraphrase: Closing ears, eyes, nostrils and lips with the fingers to meditate on the centres; book calls it hard.

sections.heading: Other Mudras
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Other mudras named but not taught here.

sections.heading: Instructions On Mudras And Bandhas
sections.label: rules
sections.paraphrase: Instructions on mudras: which go together and in which phase of breath, empty stomach, khechari/vajroli/shakti chalana only with a guru.

sections.heading: Laya Yoga
sections.label: theory
sections.paraphrase: Laya yoga: absorption of the mind; trataka and sambhavi help.

sections.heading: Anahata Sounds

sections.paraphrase: Close the ears with the thumbs and listen inward to subtle sounds, from loud to subtle. Sounds are never promised.

sections.heading: Bhakti Yoga–Classes Of Worship

sections.paraphrase: Bhakti yoga: grades of worship from elements to the formless.

sections.heading: Mantras

sections.paraphrase: Mantra as a way to awaken Kundalini, but the mantra must be received from a guru.

sections.paraphrase: Minor siddhis listed.
